desc: Derive sweep invariant: adding A_j contributes +1 to middle distinct for cuts i in [max(prev[A_j],1), j-1]; candidate at j is max_{i in [1,j-1]} (P[i]+middle) + Suf[j]
Precompute prefix distinct P[1..N-1] and suffix distinct Suf[1..N-1] using seen-sets, O(N)
Implement lazy segment tree (range add, range max) over indices 1..N-1, initialized with seg[i] = P[i]
Sweep j = 2..N-1: range-add for A_j, update prev, candidate = max over [1, j-1] + Suf[j]
Hand-trace code on Sample 1 (got 5), Sample 2 (got 9), all-equal (got 3), all-distinct (got N); verified suf indexing and that queries never touch uninitialized leaves
